t: What he said from the pulpit in the drought
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْغَنِيُّ وَنَحْنُ الْفُقَرَاءُ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا الْغَيْثَ
p: Allāhumma anta-Llāhu lā ilāha illā ant, al-ghaniyyu wa naḥnu-l-fuqarāʾ, anzil ʿalayna-l-ghayth
m: O Allah, You are Allah, there is no god but You. You are the Rich and we are the poor. Send down the rain on us.
